hero.title: Dispatch check
hero.subtitle: Load today's tracking list and scan packs to catch missed orders before they ship.

intro: Paste or upload tracking IDs from your shipment, then scan or type each pack. Unscanned IDs stay highlighted until cleared.

tips.title: Before carrier pickup
tips.body: Run the check once packing is finished and before handover.

tips.title: Missed packs
tips.body: Anything still unscanned is at risk of a late dispatch.

tips.title: Reset daily
tips.body: Clear the list when you start a new wave.

cta.heading: Want help applying these numbers to your Amazon account?
